items.name: Breaking Bad
clues: Dark, slow-burning and sometimes very funny. Many people call it the best TV series ever made.
The desert around Albuquerque, New Mexico.
The family buys a car wash so that the money from crime can look like ordinary takings.
A shy chemistry teacher with cancer starts making drugs to leave money for his family.
He calls himself Heisenberg, and his lawyer, Saul, later got his own series.
The title is an American expression for when a good person turns to crime.

items.name: Ozark
clues: Tense and grey. Even the colour of the pictures looks a bit blue and cold.
A holiday area around a big lake in Missouri.
A financial adviser has to clean millions of dollars for a drug cartel through local businesses.
The father of an ordinary family from Chicago, played by Jason Bateman, who also directed some of the episodes.
A Netflix series from 2017 to 2022. The family is called Byrde.
It's named after the mountains and the lake where the family hides.

items.name: The Wolf of Wall Street
clues: Loud, long and completely over the top: three hours of parties and bad decisions.
An office on Long Island, New York, in the late 1980s and 1990s.
Brokers sell almost worthless shares on the phone, and the boss hides his millions in Swiss bank accounts.
A real stockbroker, played by Leonardo DiCaprio in a 2013 film by Martin Scorsese.
Matthew McConaughey thumps his chest and hums at a business lunch. And: “Sell me this pen.”
The title is the main character's nickname: a wild animal, plus New York's financial district.

items.name: Peaky Blinders
clues: Dark, stylish and moody, with slow-motion walks and modern rock music over old-fashioned streets.
Small Heath, a poor part of Birmingham, just after the First World War.
A family gang runs illegal betting on horse races, then slowly turns its money into a legal business empire.
Tommy Shelby, a cool, scarred war veteran, played by Cillian Murphy, who later won an Oscar for “Oppenheimer”.
A BBC series from 2013 to 2022. The gang hide razor blades in their flat caps.
The title is the gang's name: “peaky” for the peak of their caps, and “blinders” for what the blades could do.

items.name: Money Heist
clues: Fast, emotional and very dramatic. Everyone seems to fall in love with someone.
Madrid, mostly inside one building.
The plan isn't to steal money: it's to print billions of euros of brand-new notes inside the Royal Mint of Spain.
A quiet genius called the Professor, and a gang who use the names of cities, like Tokyo, Berlin and Nairobi.
Red overalls, masks of the painter Salvador Dalí, and everybody singing “Bella ciao”.
A Spanish Netflix hit whose English title is two words: what they take, and the crime.

items.name: Ocean's Eleven
clues: Cool, relaxed and very pleased with itself. Everyone wears a nice suit.
Las Vegas.
A gang plans to empty the vault under three casinos on the night of a big boxing match.
A charming thief just out of prison, played by George Clooney. Brad Pitt plays his friend, who is always eating.
A 2001 remake of a 1960 film with Frank Sinatra. The casino owner is going out with the thief's ex-wife, played by Julia Roberts.
The title is the main character's surname plus the number of people in the gang.
